source: npm pack @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem@2026.8.31, tarball extracted and dist/*.js read (not installed, not executed)

read_file.rationale: Deprecated alias of read_text_file; returns host file content from within allowed roots (local user data, not attacker-controlled under the primary model).

read_text_file.rationale: Reads full/head/tail text of a host file; returns host file content from within allowed roots (local user data, not attacker-controlled under the primary model).

read_media_file.rationale: Returns any host file within roots base64-encoded (image/audio/embedded resource).

read_multiple_files.rationale: Returns contents of several host files within roots.

write_file.rationale: Writes agent-supplied content to a local file inside roots and returns only a fixed success string; local files are not attacker-readable, so not SINK.

edit_file.rationale: Applies edits and returns a git-style diff that includes original host file lines (also in dryRun).

create_directory.rationale: mkdir -p inside roots; returns a fixed success string.

list_directory.rationale: Returns names of host directory entries (non-public host metadata).

list_directory_with_sizes.rationale: Returns host directory entry names and sizes.

directory_tree.rationale: Returns recursive JSON tree of host file names within roots.

move_file.rationale: Renames within roots (fails if destination exists); returns a fixed success string echoing agent-supplied paths.

search_files.rationale: Returns full host paths matching a glob within roots.

get_file_info.rationale: Returns host file metadata (size, times, permissions).

list_allowed_directories.rationale: Returns the absolute host paths of the current allowed roots (host metadata; labeled SECRET for consistency with other metadata tools, verdict-insensitive because read_text_file is always present).

notes: No flag, env var or mode removes any tool or label: positional CLI args are only the allowed root directories (dist/index.js:17-50); there is no read-only switch. Docker ':ro' mounts (README.md:215) only block writes, which carry no label.

MCP roots replace CLI roots: if the client advertises the roots capability and returns >=1 valid directory, allowedDirectories is replaced entirely (dist/index.js:575-585, 600-610) and again on notifications/roots/list_changed (dist/index.js:587-598); if the client returns no valid roots, CLI roots are kept (dist/index.js:582-584). The root class recorded from CLI args may therefore not reflect effective access when the client supports roots.

Symlink escapes are blocked: validatePath does a lexical containment check, then realpath and re-check (dist/lib.js:99-116); for non-existent paths each existing component is realpath'd and re-checked (dist/lib.js:59-90,123); new files are created with flag 'wx' and overwrites use temp-file + atomic rename (dist/lib.js:155-166). No tool creates symlinks, so the agent cannot manufacture an escape; residual TOCTOU needs a concurrent local actor.

UNTRUSTED not assigned: all returned content is local files inside user-chosen roots, which PREREG's primary model treats as user-controlled even if a file originated from a third party (download, cloned repo). The secondary variant covers only user-credential stores, so secondary_extra is empty.

Not labeled HOSTEXEC: write_file/edit_file can plant files that another process may later execute (e.g., shell rc files or .git/hooks when a root covers them), but the server itself executes nothing; the same rule is applied to serena's file-editing tools.

Platform side channel not labeled: on macOS with a root of '/' (system-root class), realpath of /net/<host>/... can trigger the default automounter to contact an agent-chosen host; outside such roots the lexical check rejects the path before any I/O (dist/lib.js:104-107).
